description: Compute the SHA-256 of a local file and check it against a declared hash/attestation, plus verify the HMAC signature server-side (no file bytes are ever sent). Pass the fields as read from the certificate (hash, attestazione, hmac, and any declared titolo/autore/anno/note).

attestazione.description: The attestation string from the certificate.

hash.description: Declared SHA-256 to compare against (from the certificate).

hmac.description: The HMAC signature from the certificate.

name: verify_file
title: Verify a file against a certificate
